project: Engenharia Reversa — original REA Linux MCP only
scope: Safety of restored six P214 Evidence and any future complete Evidence+Unknown histories before, during and after binary-session transitions.

rejected_plan_hygiene.fail_reason: Individual authorization is required for binary_session (workspace category) even though its descriptor is read-only; the entire sealed batch was rejected before any tool execution.
rejected_plan_hygiene.correction: Remove unauthorized binary_session and submit only original MCP read tools in a NEW nonce. Do not invent or forge a workspace grant.

original_source_evidence.fact: closeWithSnapshot first exports and writes snapshot, then calls #closeActive; the latter defaults clearRecords=true, which clears records even if snapshot written.

exportAnalysisSnapshot on NO active target exports full Evidence bundle; on ACTIVE target it delegates to evidenceBundleForTarget(bundle, target.sha256). It can reject export if snapshot was invalidated.

evidenceBundleForTarget retains records whose subject.digest.sha256 matches active target (plus referenced mutation evidence) and retains Unknown histories eligible for that target. Unrelated Evidence/Unknowns are deliberately absent.
export_evidence_bundle atomically exports the deterministic complete Evidence bundle with overwrite control. It is distinct from a target-scoped binary snapshot.
Existing REA test first exports a complete portable Evidence bundle, then explicitly tests that close_binary clears records and unknowns.

source_contract_interpretation: Target-scoped snapshots cannot be used as proof of preservation of a multi-provider/multi-target investigation bundle.

A full export_evidence_bundle before any close is necessary when retained global Evidence or Unknown revisions matter; the archive must be verified by exact Evidence IDs and revision chain, not just a count.
Snapshot import and evidence bundle import have different schemas/semantics; never substitute one for the other or invent unavailable Evidence payloads.
Successful full export still does not make close_binary intrinsically safe: it clears current in-memory global records and requires a verified restore step with fresh exact authorization.
retention_safety_release_requirements: Before lifecycle operation, independently read exact current full Evidence bundle and Unknown histories; compare against SHA-verified persistent export archive.
Verify archive is a regular non-symlink file with strict permissions, source-owned scope, and complete records/unknown revisions; do not publish contents on GitHub.
Require fresh individual owner Ed25519 signatures and exact tool/path hashes for sensitive export/close/import operations; never reuse P229 signed request.
Validate a separate isolated source-owned REA regression fixture BEFORE using permanent MCP on restored six Evidence, including positive, negative, mismatch, restart/retention tests.

After restore, perform independent original MCP get_evidence_bundle and list_unknowns; require all original IDs, revision histories, count, and full-data integrity before removing any temporary staged copy.
Keep P232 local preseal hold on open_binary/close_binary until an explicitly approved, independently verified safety release.

operator_guard_p232.caveat: Only plans explicitly sent through local P232 helper are protected; original MCP/runtime remains unchanged.
